description: Explains a payment decline / error code of a gateway: the official meaning and source URL (from the gateway docs) plus a SUGGESTED customer message (es/en) and merchant action. Omit code to list the known codes of a gateway. Gateways: stripe, mercado-pago, conekta, openpay, netpay, clip, payu-latam, dlocal, adyen.

code.description: Decline/error code exactly as the gateway returned it.

lang.description: Language for descriptions, notes and hints. Default "en".

name: explain_decline
title: Explain a decline code
